Megan L.: launching small config-only change to smooth midday tails. change-id cfg-2026-04-10-1. keys: routing.policy=round_robin->smooth_round, batch.window_ms 18->11, per_tenant_limit=1.0->0.92, token_timeout_ms 30000->31000. canary 4% for 45m. DeployBot: config-only deploy queued cfg-2026-04-10-1, canary=4%, window=45m.
Srinivas: after 7m p95 +15% on some canary nodes, batch sizes down from p50=3 to 1.8. snippet: ```batch_hist: p50=3->1.8, p95_lat=190->220ms```
Jules: agree pin top-2 tenants (prod-x, prod-y) to prev config while observing. DeployBot: pins applied prod-x,prod-y->cfg-prev.
Megan L.: adding auto-rollback: errors>0.8% OR p95_delta>30% for 10m. DeployBot: rollback rule attached.
OpsBot: canary at 4% with pins. current metrics: p95_delta ~12%, errors 0.02%. holding for 30m then re-evaluate. Megan L.: no unrelated routing changes during observation. If anything spikes, rollback immediately.
